paragraphs.en: I'm a geophysicist by training. When my position was cut in late 2025, I built this framework to run my own job search - the same /scrape , /apply , and /interview workflow in this repo, used weekly, on my own career. I was upfront about it with every employer I spoke to, and instead of counting against me, it usually sparked a genuine technical conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 我的本行是地球物理学。 2025 年底我的职位被裁撤后，我搭建了这个框架来运行自己的求职流程——也就是本仓库中的 /scrape、/apply 和 /interview 工作流，每周都在我自己的求职上使用。 我对沟通过的每位雇主都坦白了这一点，而它非但没有对我造成负面影响，反而常常引发真诚的技术交流。

paragraphs.en: A structured workflow that turns Claude Code into a full-stack job application assistant. The core workflow (self-profiling, fit evaluation, and the drafter-reviewer application pipeline) is language- and country-agnostic . The job portal search skills are built for the Danish market (Jobindex, Jobnet, Akademikernes Jobbank, etc.), but the pattern is designed to be swapped for your local job boards.
paragraphs.zh: 一个结构化的工作流程，可将 Claude Code 变成全栈求职申请助手。 核心工作流程（自我画像、匹配度评估，以及起草者-审阅者申请流水线）与语言和国家无关。 求职门户网站搜索技能是为丹麦市场构建的（Jobindex、Jobnet、Akademikernes Jobbank 等），但该模式设计为可替换为你本地的求职网站。

paragraphs.en: /setup /scrape /apply <url> | | | v v v Fill in Search job Evaluate fit your profile portals Score & recommend | | | v v v Profile Present matches Draft CV + Cover Letter files ready with fit ratings (LaTeX, tailored) | | v v Pick a match Reviewer agent critiques -> /apply -> Revise -> Final output The framework encodes career guidance best practices, including structured evaluation criteria, forward-looking cover letter framing, and optional salary benchmarking.
paragraphs.zh: /setup /scrape /apply <url> | | | v v v 填写您的 搜索职位 评估匹配度 个人资料 门户 打分并推荐 | | | v v v 个人资料 展示匹配职位 起草简历和求职信 文件就绪 并附匹配度评分 (LaTeX，量身定制) | | v v 选择一个匹配职位 审阅智能体进行点评 -> /apply -> 修改 -> 最终输出 该框架融入了职业指导的最佳实践，包括结构化的评估标准、前瞻性的求职信表述方式，以及可选的薪资基准对比。

paragraphs.en: A fork of this repo is always public — GitHub does not allow private forks of public repositories — and /setup (step 3 below) writes your personal data (name, contact details, employment history, salary expectations) into tracked files. If this copy is for your own job search rather than for contributing changes back, use a private repository with this repo as upstream instead — the two-minute recipe is in SETUP.md section 8 , and every update workflow works identically. Fork only to contribute.

paragraphs.en: python3 tools/install_portal_clis.py # Windows: python tools\install_portal_clis.py It runs bun install in every portal CLI under .agents/skills/*/cli/ - discovered, not listed, so a portal you add with /add-portal or copy from another fork is included on a fresh clone. A CLI whose package.json declares an install-time lifecycle script is skipped and reported rather than run. --dry-run shows what it would install.
paragraphs.zh: python3 tools/install_portal_clis.py # Windows：python tools\install_portal_clis.py 它会在 .agents/skills/*/cli/ 下的每个门户 CLI 中运行 bun install——是通过发现而非列出的方式，因此你通过 /add-portal 添加或从其他 fork 复制来的门户，在全新克隆中也会被包含进来。 对于其 package.json 声明了安装期生命周期脚本的 CLI，会被跳过并报告，而不是执行。--dry-run 可显示将要安装的内容。

paragraphs.en: For linkedin-search and freehire-search the install is optional: both have zero runtime dependencies and run with plain bun ; bun install only pulls TypeScript dev types.

paragraphs.en: claude # Then inside Claude Code: /setup /setup offers three paths: read your documents/ folder if you have one populated (CV PDF, LinkedIn export, diplomas, reference letters, past applications), import a single CV pasted in chat, or walk through an interview. It auto-detects what you have and asks. Documents-folder mode is idempotent and safe to re-run as you add more material; see documents/README.md for the layout.
paragraphs.zh: claude # 然后在 Claude Code 中运行：/setup /setup 提供三条路径：如果你的 documents/ 文件夹中已有内容（简历 PDF、LinkedIn 导出、文凭、推荐信、过往申请材料），可以读取该文件夹；也可以导入一份粘贴到聊天中的简历；或者通过一次访谈逐步完成。 它会自动检测你已有的内容并进行询问。 documents 文件夹模式是幂等的，随着你添加更多材料可以安全地重复运行；目录结构请参见 documents/README.md。

paragraphs.en: /scrape This searches multiple job portals for positions matching your profile, deduplicates results, and presents them sorted by fit. Pick a match to run /apply on it directly — or, when a scrape returns more jobs than you want to eyeball, run /rank to batch-score them all against the fit framework and get a ranked shortlist first.
paragraphs.zh: /scrape 该命令会搜索多个求职网站，寻找与你的个人资料匹配的职位，对结果去重，并按匹配度排序呈现。 选中一个匹配项即可直接对其运行 /apply —— 或者，当抓取返回的职位多到你不想逐一查看时，先运行 /rank，依据匹配度框架对它们全部批量打分，得到一份排好序的入围清单。

paragraphs.en: /apply https://jobindex.dk/job/1234567 If the URL can't be fetched (some job portals block automated access), you can paste the job description directly instead:
paragraphs.zh: /apply https://jobindex.dk/job/1234567 如果无法获取该 URL（某些招聘网站会阻止自动化访问），你可以直接粘贴职位描述来代替：

paragraphs.en: /apply < paste the full job description here > This runs the full workflow: evaluate fit, draft CV + cover letter, review with a second agent, revise, and present the final output. The posting passes a deterministic integrity gate first (hidden text, invisible characters, instruction-shaped lines, hidden links), and its one-line verdict opens the evaluation; the agents that fetch and review read-only.
paragraphs.zh: /apply < 在此粘贴完整的职位描述 > 此命令会运行完整工作流：评估匹配度、起草简历和求职信、由第二个智能体进行审阅、修改，并呈现最终输出。 该职位描述会首先通过一个确定性的完整性检查（隐藏文本、不可见字符、指令形状的行、隐藏链接），其单行判定结果会开启评估流程；负责抓取和审阅的智能体均为只读。

sents.en: /apply < paste the full job description here > This runs the full workflow: evaluate fit, draft CV + cover letter, review with a second agent, revise, and present the final output.
sents.zh: /apply < 在此粘贴完整的职位描述 > 此命令会运行完整工作流：评估匹配度、起草简历和求职信、由第二个智能体进行审阅、修改，并呈现最终输出。

sents.en: The posting passes a deterministic integrity gate first (hidden text, invisible characters, instruction-shaped lines, hidden links), and its one-line verdict opens the evaluation; the agents that fetch and review read-only.
sents.zh: 该职位描述会首先通过一个确定性的完整性检查（隐藏文本、不可见字符、指令形状的行、隐藏链接），其单行判定结果会开启评估流程；负责抓取和审阅的智能体均为只读。

paragraphs.en: Postings are treated as untrusted input (the workflow follows no instructions embedded in them and fetches no links from their body), but agentic defenses are instruction-level, not a sandbox - on an unfamiliar job board, skim what was fetched and written before you hit send. Details in SECURITY.md .
paragraphs.zh: 帖子被视为不可信输入（工作流不会遵循其中嵌入的指令，也不会从其正文中抓取链接），但智能体防御是指令级别的，而非沙箱——在不熟悉的招聘网站上，请在点击发送之前浏览一下抓取和写入了哪些内容。详情见 SECURITY.md。

paragraphs.en: As your priorities evolve, you can reconfigure just the job search without re-running the full profile setup:
paragraphs.zh: 随着你的优先级不断变化，你可以只重新配置求职任务，而无需重新运行完整的个人资料设置：

paragraphs.en: /setup --section search This re-runs the search configuration interview: which roles to target, which skills to search for, which locations, and which portals. It also suggests role types you may not have considered based on your profile.
paragraphs.zh: /setup --section search 这将重新运行搜索配置问答：要瞄准哪些职位、搜索哪些技能、哪些地点以及哪些招聘网站。 它还会根据你的个人资料建议你可能没有考虑过的职位类型。

paragraphs.en: To use your own template instead — LaTeX, Typst , or any other toolchain that compiles to PDF from the command line — run:
paragraphs.zh: 若要改用你自己的模板——LaTeX、Typst 或任何其他可从命令行编译为 PDF 的工具链——请运行：

paragraphs.en: /add-template Point it at your source file (a .tex file plus any .cls / .sty files or bundled fonts; a .typ file plus any local packages; or an equivalent for another toolchain). The command interviews you for the template's instructions — source extension, compile command, fonts and where they live, style rules to preserve, hard page limit — stores everything under templates/ , runs a mandatory test compile, and activates the template so /apply drafts and compiles from it. Templates are stored with [PLACEHOLDER] tokens instead of personal data, so they're safe to commit and share.
paragraphs.zh: /add-template 请将命令指向你的源文件（一个 .tex 文件外加任意 .cls / .sty 文件或内置字体；一个 .typ 文件外加任意本地宏包；或其他工具链的等价物）。 该命令会通过问答方式获取模板的相关配置——源文件扩展名、编译命令、字体及其存放位置、需保留的样式规则、硬性页数上限——然后将所有内容存储在 templates/ 目录下，运行一次强制的测试编译，并激活该模板，使 /apply 能基于它起草并编译。 模板以 [PLACEHOLDER] 占位符存储而非个人数据，因此可以安全地提交和共享。

sents.en: The four Danish CLI tools in .agents/skills/ (Jobbank, Jobdanmark, Jobindex, Jobnet) demonstrate the pattern for building a job-portal integration for a specific market.
sents.zh: .agents/skills/ 中的四个丹麦 CLI 工具（Jobbank、Jobdanmark、Jobindex、Jobnet）演示了为特定市场构建职位门户网站集成的模式。

sents.en: If you're in a different country, run:
sents.zh: 如果你在其他国家/地区，请运行：

paragraphs.en: /add-portal Give it your local job board's URL. The command investigates the portal (search-URL pattern, result-page structure, robots.txt/access rules), scaffolds a CLI skill with the same structure, commands, and output contract as the shipped ones, and test-runs a live query before registering anything. Auth-walled portals are declined, and portals with restrictive terms get a prominent personal-use-only warning in the generated skill. The generated skill is market-specific and lives in your fork; the generator itself is the universal part.
paragraphs.zh: /add-portal 输入你本地招聘信息板的网址。 该命令会调查该门户（搜索 URL 模式、结果页结构、robots.txt/访问规则），按照与内置技能相同的结构、命令和输出约定生成一个 CLI 技能，并在注册之前实际试运行一次查询。 有身份验证墙的门户会被拒绝，而条款限制较多的门户会在生成的技能中得到醒目的「仅限个人使用」警告。 生成的技能是特定于市场的，存放在你的 fork 中；生成器本身才是通用的部分。

paragraphs.en: Borrowing a portal skill from another fork is the intended way to get a board that upstream doesn't ship: find it in the portal index , open that fork, and copy the one folder into your own .agents/skills/ . Before you run it:
paragraphs.zh: 从其他分支（fork）借用的门户技能是获得上游未提供的面板的预期方式：在门户索引中找到它，打开该分支，然后将那一个文件夹复制到你自己的 .agents/skills/ 中。运行之前：

paragraphs.en: The copy step is manual on purpose. Your settings already allow installed portal skills to run without asking each time - so an installer that fetched them from third-party repos for you would skip the one check that matters: you, reading the code first. There isn't one, and that's a security decision rather than a missing feature.
paragraphs.zh: 复制这一步是刻意设计为手动的。 你的设置已经允许已安装的门户技能在运行时不再每次询问——因此，一个替你从第三方仓库获取它们的安装程序会跳过最重要的那一道检查：由你先阅读代码。 没有这个功能，这是出于安全考虑的决定，而不是缺失的功能。

paragraphs.en: Upstream moves fast. Rather than pulling raw master and hoping, update your fork to a tagged release - a vetted checkpoint described in CHANGELOG.md . python3 tools/check_upstream_updates.py previews exactly which of your personalized files an update touches before you merge, and python3 tools/upstream_triage.py sorts the commits you're behind into "worth reviewing" vs "probably skip" (a weekly workflow can post this to a rolling issue). Full walkthrough in SETUP.md, section 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 上游更新很快。 与其直接拉取原始 master 分支然后祈祷不出问题，不如将你的分支更新到某个带标签的发布版本——这是 CHANGELOG.md 中描述的经过审核的检查点。python3 tools/check_upstream_updates.py 可以在你合并之前预览更新会触及哪些你的个性化文件，而 python3 tools/upstream_triage.py 会将你落后的提交分为“值得审查”和“大概可以跳过”两类（可以设置每周工作流将此结果发布到一个滚动更新的 issue 中）。 完整流程参见 SETUP.md 第 8 节。

paragraphs.en: The single biggest factor in output quality is how much detail you put into your profile. A thin profile produces generic applications; a detailed one enables genuinely tailored results.
paragraphs.zh: 影响输出质量的最大单一因素是你在个人资料中填入多少细节。 薄弱的个人资料会产生千篇一律的申请；详实的个人资料才能真正实现量身定制的结果。

paragraphs.en: To get the most from this, invest time during /setup in describing not just your experience, but what energized you, what drained you, and what you'd want more of. This context directly shapes how the system evaluates fit and which roles it surfaces during /scrape .
paragraphs.zh: 为了获得最佳效果，请在 /setup 阶段投入时间描述你的经历，不仅包括你的经验，还包括什么让你充满活力、什么让你感到疲惫，以及你希望获得更多什么。 这些背景信息直接影响系统如何评估匹配度，以及 /scrape 期间它会筛选出哪些角色。
